name: leo
title: Leo · Aleo · zkworld
description: The Leo · Aleo framework as a running submod of zkworld: its toolchain, starters and every Leo · Aleo project here. A Rust-like, private-by-default language for Aleo programs. leo builds Aleo instructions, `leo run` executes off-chain and @test fns run in-VM. Shared JSON cases run through `leo run`.
